sources.title: Qwen3.5-2B model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: exact post-trained checkpoint lists nominal 2B under Language Model, a vision encoder, dense FFNs, tied embeddings and multi-step MTP. Neither its overview nor benchmark tables supplies a separate activated-parameter count.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-2B configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration has 24 text layers, alternating three linear-attention layers with one full-attention layer, dense intermediate_size 6144, tied embeddings, a vision configuration and max_position_embeddings 262144.

sources.title: Official checkpoint repository metadata
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27 at repository revision 15852e8c16360a2fea060d615a32b45270f8a8fc: safetensors metadata still reports 2,274,069,824 stored parameters (2,274,067,232 BF16 plus 2,592 F32). This full checkpoint count differs from the rounded language-model size.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-2B Apache License
sources.evidence: Apache License 2.0 with Copyright 2026 Alibaba Cloud.

sources.title: Official Qwen repository release news
sources.evidence: News explicitly announces Qwen3.5-2B availability on Hugging Face and ModelScope on 2026-03-02. The former Qwen3.5 repository redirects here and retains its release chronology.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-2B checkpoint tensor index
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: checkpoint tensor index contains language-model, 297 visual-encoder/merger tensor keys and 15 MTP tensor keys, with no expert keys; metadata total_size is 4,548,144,832 bytes. No weight shards were downloaded.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-0.8B model card and comparison tables
sources.evidence: Fresh comparison-table check: language and vision benchmark tables explicitly include Qwen3.5-2B, but supply no total/activated-parameter row for it.

sources.title: Later Qwen3.8-27B model card
sources.evidence: Fresh later-release check: the overview and comparison tables do not include a Qwen3.5-2B activated-parameter disclosure. Qwen3.6-27B and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B cards were also checked with the same result; this card is not positive count evidence for 2B.

sources.title: Alibaba Cloud Smart Studio supported training models
sources.evidence: Current supported-model table lists Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B as a VLM with Model Size 2B alongside Qwen3.6 releases. The table has no activated-parameter column; it corroborates only the nominal size.

sources.title: IFM K2-Horizon-0.9B comparison table
sources.evidence: The reference-model table labels Qwen3.5-2B as 2B Params, 2B Activated params and Dense. This is a competitor-published comparison, not a Qwen developer disclosure; it gives no Qwen source or counting convention for that active figure, so it is retained as a secondary lead and does not establish a verified active count.

name.note: Display-name spacing corresponds to official Qwen3.5-2B.

parameters_b.note: Fresh metadata check confirms 2,274,069,824 stored parameters across the released language, vision and MTP tensors. Preserve this exact checkpoint total; Qwen and Alibaba Cloud separately advertise a nominal 2B model size, with the card explicitly scoping 2B to the language model.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh searches of exact and later Qwen cards and Alibaba Cloud model tables found no developer-published active count for 2B. IFM labels it 2B active in a competitor comparison without Qwen attribution or a counting convention. Dense FFNs and nominal size alone do not establish active parameters across language, vision and optional MTP execution.

architecture.note: Dense FFNs with hybrid Gated DeltaNet/full attention and a vision encoder. Generic family-level MoE highlights on the card do not describe this checkpoint.

modalities.note: Text generation with image and video input examples and corresponding configuration tokens.

reasoning.note: Thinking is supported but disabled by default for 2B.

tool_call.note: Exact 2B serving and Qwen-Agent examples document function/tool use.

description.value: Post-trained Qwen3.5 vision-language model with dense feed-forward layers, hybrid attention, optional thinking and tool calling.
description.note: Replaces unqualified speed language with documented architecture and capabilities.

patch.description: Post-trained Qwen3.5 vision-language model with dense feed-forward layers, hybrid attention, optional thinking and tool calling.

sources.label: Alibaba Cloud Smart Studio supported training models

patch.notes: Full checkpoint metadata reports 2.274069824B stored parameters, including vision and MTP; the card scopes nominal 2B to the language model. Dense FFNs use hybrid linear/full attention. Qwen has not separately disclosed an active count. Thinking is optional and off by default. Release date is the official open-weight announcement.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit preserves the verified 2.274069824B checkpoint total and nominal 2B language-model context. Exact and later Qwen cards and current Alibaba Cloud tables do not disclose a separate active count; an unattributed 2B active figure in an IFM comparison is insufficient to replace null. Other audited fields are unchanged.
